name: 0DTE Power-Hour ATM Lotto
summary: Buy a cheap near-the-money 0DTE option in the final hour to exploit end-of-day gamma and closing-imbalance drift. Very high variance, marked as speculative.

legs.strike_rule: First strike 0.20-0.35 delta in the direction of the closing drift; use a put instead of a call for a downside drift

max_profit: Large multiples of a tiny debit (3x-10x) when the close trends
max_loss: Debit x 100; total loss is the base case (>70% of the time)

greeks.delta: 0.20-0.35 and climbing fast if it works
greeks.gamma: maximal - this is a pure gamma trade
greeks.theta: terminal; the option is worthless at 16:00 ET unless ITM

when_to_use: Only when there is an identifiable closing driver: a strong trend day (price above VWAP all afternoon for calls), a large MOC imbalance, or an index rebalance day. Never on a flat, mean-reverting afternoon.
entry_rules: Trend gate: underlying has been on the same side of VWAP for the last 90 minutes and the 15-min trend is intact
Debit <= 0.25% of equity (~$125 on $50k); max 1 position per day
Option price between $0.10 and $0.60 - outside that band the risk/reward does not justify the variance
management_rules: No stop loss - the debit is the risk. Position size is the only control
If price crosses back through VWAP, exit immediately regardless of P&L
exit_rules: Sell to close at +150%, on a VWAP cross-back, or at 15:50 ET
HARD FLATTEN at 15:50 ET with no exceptions. An ITM contract left at 16:00 is auto-exercised into 100 shares (call) or short 100 shares (put) with settlement the next business day
assignment_risk: None (long) but auto-exercise is the primary operational hazard - this strategy sits closest to the bell of anything in the bank.
liquidity_needs: SPY/QQQ only; spreads widen after 15:45 so the flatten must not be late.
common_mistakes: Letting it ride to the bell hoping for the last tick; trading it every day rather than only on trend days.
zero_dte_notes: This is the highest-variance entry in the bank. Include it in backtests to quantify it, but expect a hit rate under 30% with a fat right tail. Do not deploy real size until the backtest confirms positive expectancy over >200 samples.
